samples.description: One observation per unambiguous GVKEY-month linked to a CRSP primary common share on NYSE/AMEX/Nasdaq, July 1966–December 2002. Includes raw monthly total returns, lagged-return controls requiring complete calendar-month histories, latest eligible annual size/book-to-market, and independent 1-, 2-, and 3-fiscal-year NOA/Accruals eligibility fields. Model-specific complete-case samples are applied in Stata.

assumptions: OLS within each monthly cross-section; the paper names Fama–MacBeth but not the first-stage estimator.
The most recent annual record available at least four calendar months after fiscal year-end is the panel A (one-year-lag) predictor and is held for at most 12 months.
Monthly outcome uses CRSP RET with observed same-month delisting returns compounded into the security return.
OLS within each monthly cross-section; the paper names Fama–MacBeth but not the first-stage estimator.

Panel B uses the preceding fiscal-year annual NOA/Accruals record relative to the latest record eligible after the four-month fiscal-year-end gap; size and book-to-market use the latest eligible annual refresh.
Monthly outcome uses CRSP RET with observed same-month delisting returns compounded into the security return.
OLS within each monthly cross-section; the paper names Fama–MacBeth but not the first-stage estimator.

Panel C uses the annual NOA/Accruals record two fiscal years before the latest record eligible after the four-month fiscal-year-end gap; size and book-to-market use the latest eligible annual refresh.
Monthly outcome uses CRSP RET with observed same-month delisting returns compounded into the security return.
